request.geographyProse: A half-flooded warren behind the plunge pool of a waterfall that falls into the ground, at the edge of a peat marsh. Wet worked-stone halls near the entrance; older, drier stonework below. One concealed water entrance via an eel-run under the falls.

factions.name: Goblinoid Raiders
factions.prose: A goblinoid warband running the site as a toll operation on the marsh road: tolls, hostages, plunder awaiting pickup. They avoid the lowest level entirely.
